title: 作

sentences.text: 老師把手作道具放在桌上。
sentences.spokenText: 老師把手作道具放在桌上
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L242-S01 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A recurring teacher in a classroom places handmade props on a tabletop. The props may be plain paper masks with no marks, handmade toys, and simple teaching objects made from paper or safe materials.
Visual cast: recurring teacher identity: adult teacher, tidy classroom clothing, calm instructional posture, clearly different from protagonist mother, not the L058 adult woman. No protagonist mother in this scene. L058 images are style references only, not character references.
Composition: center the teacher, the table, and the handmade props; keep props large and phone-readable; classroom background is simple.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft transparent watercolor, delicate colored-pencil linework, clean warm classroom light.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, blackboard writing, labels, brand marks, logos, price tags, signs, zhuyin, watermarks, readable marks, or printed marks on props or classroom walls.
sentences.imageNotes: 老師在教室裡把手作道具放在桌上，道具可以是紙做的面具、手工玩具或簡單教具。老師要使用 recurring teacher identity，不能長得像主角媽媽。桌面、道具和教室背景不可有文字、數字、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L242-S02 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A night market scene where many different stall workers and shopkeepers are working: arranging goods, selling items, and closing or tidying stalls. Protagonist little girl and protagonist mother may walk through the night market as observers.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 continuity: pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Protagonist mother follows L154/L162/L163 continuity: shoulder-length dark hair, white or beige top, wide blue pants. Night-market workers are varied adult roles with different ages, genders, hairstyles, clothing, and body shapes; they must not all look like protagonist mother or the teacher. L058 is style reference only.
Composition: show several workers actively doing work, with mother and girl walking through; keep a lively but uncluttered square crop with safe margins.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, soft evening lights, friendly daily-life scene, not dark or chaotic.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, signs, stall names, price boards, labels, zhuyin, logos, brands, watermarks, readable marks, or price tags.
sentences.imageNotes: 夜市裡有很多不同店家和攤販正在工作，例如整理物品、賣東西或收拾攤位。可有主角小女孩和主角媽媽走過夜市。夜市工作者要是不同角色，不能都長得像主角媽媽或老師。不可有文字、數字、招牌、價格、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L242-S03 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A market late at night after closing: stalls are quiet and mostly closed, very few lights are on, and the overall market feels dark but safe and clear. View from a little distance so the empty market is understandable.
Visual cast: no main people are needed; if any distant figure appears, make them tiny and generic, not the protagonist family. L058 is style reference only, not person reference.
Composition: center the dark quiet market aisle with closed plain stalls and dim light; keep the scene non-scary, calm, and readable in a square crop.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, gentle nighttime palette, safe calm mood, soft shadows.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, signs, stall names, price boards, labels, zhuyin, logos, brands, watermarks, readable marks, horror elements, or danger.
sentences.imageNotes: 半夜的市場已經關了，攤位安靜，燈很少，整體很黑但安全清楚。可從遠處看見市場空蕩，不要做成恐怖畫面。不可有文字、數字、招牌、價格、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L242-S04 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. An independent writer character works at a home writing desk. The writer's main tool is one clear pen on the desk; there may be blank paper or a plain notebook, but no readable writing.
Visual cast: writer is an independent adult role, visually distinct from protagonist mother and from the recurring teacher; different hairstyle, face shape, clothing, and posture. No protagonist mother or teacher in this scene. L058 is style reference only, not character reference.
Composition: center the writer, desk, and the pen as the main tool; pen must be large enough to identify; desk area uncluttered.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, cozy home or study interior, soft natural light, delicate colored-pencil linework.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, readable writing on paper, book titles, labels, brand marks, logos, watermarks, signs, zhuyin, or printed marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 一位作家在家中或書桌前工作，桌上主要工具是一枝筆，旁邊可有紙本或空白稿紙但不可有可讀文字。作家是獨立成人角色，不能長得像主角媽媽或老師。畫面要清楚呈現「作家的工具就是筆」。不可有文字、數字、品牌或標籤。

sentences.text: 工作桌上放著很多工具。
sentences.spokenText: 工作桌上放著很多工具
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L242-S05 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A work table has many safe tools neatly arranged: brushes, a small wooden mallet, ruler-shaped plain tools without markings, simple craft tools, and soft materials. Protagonist little girl may stand beside the table looking, but she is not holding dangerous tools.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 continuity: pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. L058 is style reference only, not character reference.
Composition: center the tabletop and many tools; keep every tool safe-looking, rounded, and phone-readable; girl observes from the side with safe distance.
Style: refined warm watercolor children's textbook illustration, warm workshop or craft-room light, clean and orderly.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, ruler markings, labels, brand marks, logos, watermarks, sharp dangerous blades, needles, saws, signs, zhuyin, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 一張工作桌上整齊放著很多安全工具，例如刷子、小木槌、尺形工具或簡單手作工具；不要有危險尖銳感。可有主角小女孩在旁邊看，但不要讓她拿危險工具。不可有文字、數字、品牌或標籤。
